name: vigil
description: MCPWatch: observability for MCP servers. One line instruments any Python MCP server (FastMCP and the low-level Server) and tracks per-tool latency (p50/p95/p99), error rates, silent failures (empty/null returns and isError), and call volume. REST API, CLI, and alert hooks. MIT, no config required.
